# ROLEPLAY RULES
Hullrot: Eclipsion is a roleplay heavy environment. Because of that, a few situations need to be spelled out so everyone knows where the line sits when they come up in a round.
# MUTINY
Turning on your faction's commanding position should never be attempted under normal circumstances. Special cases can override this, but only with prior [bold]admin approval[/bold].
[bold]Examples:[/bold]
- Killing your commanding officer after a reckless order that got allies killed.
- Stirring up unrest inside your faction to overthrow its leadership and take control of an operation.
# ROUND REMOVAL (RR)
Round removal is taking away a player's chance to be revived after they die.
[bold]Examples:[/bold]
- Beheading a player or removing their brain specifically so they cannot return to their body.
- Ashing, spacing, or otherwise making a player's corpse impossible to recover.
Round removal is [color=lightgreen]allowed[/color] during active combat between two or more factions.
Round removal is [bold][color=red]FORBIDDEN[/color][/bold] between two players of the same faction under [bold]any circumstance[/bold].
# HATE SPEECH (xenophobia, specism, slurs)
This server has a dark atmosphere by design, so some antagonistic behavior is allowed [bold]in character[/bold]. This only ever means prejudice between the setting's own species and factions, such as a human looking down on a lizardperson. Real world hate speech has no place here. Even in character you are still expected to hold a higher standard and not use that freedom to ruin the game for someone [bold]on your own side[/bold].
[bold]Examples:[/bold]
[color=lightgreen]Allowed[/color]
- Specism between characters of un-allied or enemy factions that builds into conflict and eventually combat.
- Mild xenophobia between species or an ongoing feud between two characters of the same faction that [bold]does not[/bold] lead to combat.
[color=red]Not Allowed[/color]
- Two allied faction members fighting over an insult that was never escalated.
- Attacking one or more allied faction members with or without any buildup.
- Malding [bold]out of character[/bold] about dying and throwing slurs at another player.
